title: P9: daemon and spawn hygiene — no ancestor stamp on uncommitted work, hold when the executor did not commit, fix rounds based on their parent task branch
spec:
Three pipeline gotchas from 2026-09-19 (gotchas.md, T-0222 and T-0229).
1. orchestrator/daemon.py already_merged(): only treat a task as merged-by-ancestor when its branch head differs from the goal branch's merge-base with it AND the branch is an ancestor of the target (i.e. the task has at least one commit that landed). A branch equal to the target head is not merged work.
2. gate(): a done execute task whose worktree has uncommitted tracked or untracked changes under its scope holds with hold_reason 'executor did not commit' (resume_hint lists the dirty paths) instead of gating a stale HEAD; the Planner then commits or re-specs. Ignore .orchestrator/ state files and .venv when judging dirtiness.
3. orchestrator/spawn.py base_for(): when constraints.fix_round_for names a task whose task/<id> branch exists, cut the worktree from that branch instead of goal/<parent>, so fix rounds start on the code they fix.
Tests: tests/test_daemon.py::test_already_merged_ignores_branch_equal_to_target, ::test_gate_holds_dirty_worktree; tests/test_spawn.py::test_base_for_prefers_fix_round_parent (real temp git repo where needed).
acceptance: All existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree
